name: Kairon
shortDescription: An LLM based life organizer with RPG elements
fullDescription: Kairon is an AI-powered life management application that gamifies personal productivity. It combines large language models with role-playing game mechanics to help users organize their tasks and goals in an engaging way.

name: Gravitas
shortDescription: Simple private cloud based weight tracker app for android
fullDescription: Gravitas is a privacy-focused weight tracking application for Android devices. Built with React Native and powered by a Python backend hosted on DigitalOcean, it provides a secure and simple way to monitor your fitness journey with cloud synchronization.

name: Consent
shortDescription: Game jam entry, Papers please inspired clinic horror game
fullDescription: Consent is a narrative-driven horror game created for a game jam. Inspired by Papers, Please, it puts players in the role of a clinic worker making difficult decisions. Built entirely in GDScript using the Godot engine, it explores themes of autonomy and ethical dilemmas in a tense, atmospheric setting.

name: ASBIO
shortDescription: A lightweight web application for managing small-scale gaming tournaments (10-50 players).
fullDescription: Players register, join tournaments, and compete across multiple games. Administrators create tournaments, manage brackets, and enter results. All scores feed into a unified leaderboard that rewards both performance and participation.

name: Discord Gemini Bot
shortDescription: TTS Discord bot using Google Gemini LLM API with personality and language configuration.
fullDescription: Hungarian AI teaching assistant who explains programming concepts with a unique blend of technical expertise and dad humor. He speaks in voice channels, switches between Hungarian and English, and brings personality to your Discord server!
